	set_variable = { which = pe_va_tmp value = 0 }
	pe_job_count = { JOB = pe_private_miner }
	pe_job_res = { CAT = pe_private_miners RES = minerals }
	pe_job_res = { CAT = pe_private_miners RES = alloys }
	pe_job_res = { CAT = pe_private_miners RES = food }
	pe_job_res = { CAT = pe_private_miners RES = energy }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_jobn value >= 0.5 } }
		set_variable = { which = pe_vaj_pe_private_miner value = pe_va_tmp }
		divide_variable = { which = pe_vaj_pe_private_miner value = pe_jobn }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { which = pe_vaj_pe_private_miner value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { is_catalytic_empire = yes }
			set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_s_minerals } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 4 } change_variable = { which = pe_vaj_pe_private_miner value = pe_tmp }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_s_minerals } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 4 } change_variable = { which = pe_vaj_pe_private_miner value = pe_tmp }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { which = pe_va_tmp value = 0 }
	pe_job_count = { JOB = pe_private_technician }
	pe_job_res = { CAT = pe_private_technicians RES = energy }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_jobn value >= 0.5 } }
		set_variable = { which = pe_vaj_pe_private_technician value = pe_va_tmp }
		divide_variable = { which = pe_vaj_pe_private_technician value = pe_jobn }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { which = pe_vaj_pe_private_technician value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { is_catalytic_empire = yes }
			set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_s_energy } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 6 } change_variable = { which = pe_vaj_pe_private_technician value = pe_tmp }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_s_energy } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 6 } change_variable = { which = pe_vaj_pe_private_technician value = pe_tmp }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { which = pe_va_tmp value = 0 }
	pe_job_count = { JOB = pe_private_farmer }
	pe_job_res = { CAT = pe_private_farmers RES = food }
	pe_job_res = { CAT = pe_private_farmers RES = trade }
	pe_job_res = { CAT = pe_private_farmers RES = alloys }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_jobn value >= 0.5 } }
		set_variable = { which = pe_vaj_pe_private_farmer value = pe_va_tmp }
		divide_variable = { which = pe_vaj_pe_private_farmer value = pe_jobn }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { which = pe_vaj_pe_private_farmer value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { is_catalytic_empire = yes }
			set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_s_food } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 6 } change_variable = { which = pe_vaj_pe_private_farmer value = pe_tmp }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_s_food } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 6 } change_variable = { which = pe_vaj_pe_private_farmer value = pe_tmp }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. pe_va_<firm>: value added of the variant at stage 1, fully staffed
# (entertainment is added per planet). pe_val_<firm>: the same with diminishing value for
# repeated shares (1 / 0.75) and -5% per existing firm with the same main
# product (at least half), used to choose. Also pe_dval_<rural> = value of a rural state
# district.

# Colony scope: planet-specific values in root variables. pe_dval_u = value of one state
# city district on this planet (from its zones). pe_ent_val = value of one
# entertainer job here (amenity shortage), pe_spec_<letter> = 1.25 for shares that match the
# planet's designation, else 1.
pe_planet_prepare = {
	root = {
		set_variable = { which = pe_spec_a value = 1 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_spec_c value = 1 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_spec_t value = 1 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_spec_u value = 1 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_spec_x value = 1 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_spec_y value = 1 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_spec_z value = 1 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_spec_m value = 1 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_spec_e value = 1 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_spec_f value = 1 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_ent_val value = 0.3 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_dval_u value = 0 }
	}
	# Value of one state city district here: one job per zone (100 workforce each).
	if = { limit = { num_zones = { type = zone_foundry value > 0 } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_metallurgist } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 1 } change_variable = { which = pe_dval_u value = pe_tmp } } }
	if = { limit = { num_zones = { type = zone_factory value > 0 } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_artisan } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 1 } change_variable = { which = pe_dval_u value = pe_tmp } } }
	if = { limit = { num_zones = { type = zone_industrial value > 0 } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_metallurgist } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.5 } change_variable = { which = pe_dval_u value = pe_tmp } set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_artisan } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.5 } change_variable = { which = pe_dval_u value = pe_tmp } } }
	if = { limit = { num_zones = { type = zone_trade value > 0 } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_trader } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 1 } change_variable = { which = pe_dval_u value = pe_tmp } } }
	if = { limit = { num_zones = { type = zone_research value > 0 } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_physicist } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.3333 } change_variable = { which = pe_dval_u value = pe_tmp } set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_biologist } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.3333 } change_variable = { which = pe_dval_u value = pe_tmp } set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_engineer } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.3333 } change_variable = { which = pe_dval_u value = pe_tmp } } }
	if = { limit = { num_zones = { type = zone_research_physics value > 0 } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_physicist } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 1 } change_variable = { which = pe_dval_u value = pe_tmp } } }
	if = { limit = { num_zones = { type = zone_research_society value > 0 } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_biologist } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 1 } change_variable = { which = pe_dval_u value = pe_tmp } } }
	if = { limit = { num_zones = { type = zone_research_engineering value > 0 } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_engineer } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 1 } change_variable = { which = pe_dval_u value = pe_tmp } } }
	if = { limit = { num_zones = { type = zone_research_unity value > 0 } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_physicist } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.3333 } change_variable = { which = pe_dval_u value = pe_tmp } set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_biologist } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.3333 } change_variable = { which = pe_dval_u value = pe_tmp } set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_engineer } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.3333 } change_variable = { which = pe_dval_u value = pe_tmp } } }
	if = { limit = { num_zones = { type = zone_unity value > 0 } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_physicist } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.3333 } change_variable = { which = pe_dval_u value = pe_tmp } set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_biologist } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.3333 } change_variable = { which = pe_dval_u value = pe_tmp } set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_engineer } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.3333 } change_variable = { which = pe_dval_u value = pe_tmp } } }
	if = { limit = { num_zones = { type = zone_unity_spiritualist value > 0 } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_physicist } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.3333 } change_variable = { which = pe_dval_u value = pe_tmp } set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_biologist } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.3333 } change_variable = { which = pe_dval_u value = pe_tmp } set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_engineer } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.3333 } change_variable = { which = pe_dval_u value = pe_tmp } } }
	if = { limit = { num_zones = { type = zone_unity_bio_trophy value > 0 } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_physicist } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.3333 } change_variable = { which = pe_dval_u value = pe_tmp } set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_biologist } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.3333 } change_variable = { which = pe_dval_u value = pe_tmp } set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_engineer } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.3333 } change_variable = { which = pe_dval_u value = pe_tmp } } }
	if = { limit = { num_zones = { type = zone_resort_entertainment value > 0 } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_entertainer } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 1 } change_variable = { which = pe_dval_u value = pe_tmp } } }
	if = { limit = { free_amenities < 0 } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_ent_val value = 12 } } }
	else_if = { limit = { free_amenities < 1000 } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_ent_val value = 4 } } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { has_designation = col_industrial has_designation = col_foundry has_designation = col_capital_foundry } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_spec_a value = 1.25 } } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { has_designation = col_industrial has_designation = col_factory has_designation = col_capital_factory } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_spec_c value = 1.25 } } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { has_designation = col_city has_designation = col_capital_trade } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_spec_t value = 1.25 } } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { has_designation = col_resort has_designation = col_pleasure } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_spec_u value = 1.25 } } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { has_designation = col_research } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_spec_x value = 1.25 } } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { has_designation = col_research } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_spec_y value = 1.25 } } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { has_designation = col_research } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_spec_z value = 1.25 } } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { has_designation = col_mining has_designation = col_capital_extraction } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_spec_m value = 1.25 } } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { has_designation = col_generator } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_spec_e value = 1.25 } } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { has_designation = col_farming } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_spec_f value = 1.25 } } }
}

	else_if = { limit = { is_deposit_type = d_pe_firm_fm_3 } set_variable = { which = pe_code value = 33 } set_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 3 } }
	else_if = { limit = { is_deposit_type = d_pe_firm_fe } set_variable = { which = pe_code value = 34 } set_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { is_deposit_type = d_pe_firm_fe_2 } set_variable = { which = pe_code value = 34 } set_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 2 } }
	else_if = { limit = { is_deposit_type = d_pe_firm_fe_3 } set_variable = { which = pe_code value = 34 } set_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 3 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { is_variable_set = pe_fcap } } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = 0 } }
}

# Deposit scope: this quarter's values of the firm's variant (entertainment valued for
# this planet), and its class (1 city, 2 mining, 3 generator, 4 farming, 5 lab).
pe_deposit_fetch = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_code value = 1 } } set_variable = { which = pe_va value = root.pe_va_d_pe_firm_aa } set_variable = { which = pe_val value = root.pe_val_d_pe_firm_aa } set_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_code value = 2 } } set_variable = { which = pe_va value = root.pe_va_d_pe_firm_ac } set_variable = { which = pe_val value = root.pe_val_d_pe_firm_ac } set_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_code value = 3 } } set_variable = { which = pe_va value = root.pe_va_d_pe_firm_at } set_variable = { which = pe_val value = root.pe_val_d_pe_firm_at } set_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_code value = 4 } } set_variable = { which = pe_va value = root.pe_va_d_pe_firm_au } set_variable = { which = pe_val value = root.pe_val_d_pe_firm_au } set_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = root.pe_ent_val } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 1 } change_variable = { which = pe_va value = pe_tmp } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_code value = 5 } } set_variable = { which = pe_va value = root.pe_va_d_pe_firm_cc } set_variable = { which = pe_val value = root.pe_val_d_pe_firm_cc } set_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_code value = 6 } } set_variable = { which = pe_va value = root.pe_va_d_pe_firm_ct } set_variable = { which = pe_val value = root.pe_val_d_pe_firm_ct } set_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_code value = 7 } } set_variable = { which = pe_va value = root.pe_va_d_pe_firm_cu } set_variable = { which = pe_val value = root.pe_val_d_pe_firm_cu } set_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = root.pe_ent_val } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 1 } change_variable = { which = pe_va value = pe_tmp } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_code value = 8 } } set_variable = { which = pe_va value = root.pe_va_d_pe_firm_tt } set_variable = { which = pe_val value = root.pe_val_d_pe_firm_tt } set_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_code value = 9 } } set_variable = { which = pe_va value = root.pe_va_d_pe_firm_tu } set_variable = { which = pe_val value = root.pe_val_d_pe_firm_tu } set_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = root.pe_ent_val } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 1 } change_variable = { which = pe_va value = pe_tmp } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_code value = 10 } } set_variable = { which = pe_va value = root.pe_va_d_pe_firm_uu } set_variable = { which = pe_val value = root.pe_val_d_pe_firm_uu } set_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = root.pe_ent_val } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 2 } change_variable = { which = pe_va value = pe_tmp } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_code value = 11 } } set_variable = { which = pe_va value = root.pe_va_d_pe_firm_xx } set_variable = { which = pe_val value = root.pe_val_d_pe_firm_xx } set_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 5 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_code value = 12 } } set_variable = { which = pe_va value = root.pe_va_d_pe_firm_xy } set_variable = { which = pe_val value = root.pe_val_d_pe_firm_xy } set_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 5 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_code value = 13 } } set_variable = { which = pe_va value = root.pe_va_d_pe_firm_xz } set_variable = { which = pe_val value = root.pe_val_d_pe_firm_xz } set_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 5 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_code value = 14 } } set_variable = { which = pe_va value = root.pe_va_d_pe_firm_yy } set_variable = { which = pe_val value = root.pe_val_d_pe_firm_yy } set_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 5 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_code value = 15 } } set_variable = { which = pe_va value = root.pe_va_d_pe_firm_yz } set_variable = { which = pe_val value = root.pe_val_d_pe_firm_yz } set_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 5 } }

	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_code value = 30 } } set_variable = { which = pe_va value = root.pe_va_d_pe_firm_fa } set_variable = { which = pe_val value = root.pe_val_d_pe_firm_fa } set_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 4 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_code value = 31 } } set_variable = { which = pe_va value = root.pe_va_d_pe_firm_fc } set_variable = { which = pe_val value = root.pe_val_d_pe_firm_fc } set_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 4 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_code value = 32 } } set_variable = { which = pe_va value = root.pe_va_d_pe_firm_ft } set_variable = { which = pe_val value = root.pe_val_d_pe_firm_ft } set_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 4 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_code value = 33 } } set_variable = { which = pe_va value = root.pe_va_d_pe_firm_fm } set_variable = { which = pe_val value = root.pe_val_d_pe_firm_fm } set_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 4 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_code value = 34 } } set_variable = { which = pe_va value = root.pe_va_d_pe_firm_fe } set_variable = { which = pe_val value = root.pe_val_d_pe_firm_fe } set_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 4 } }
}

# Colony scope: root.pe_best_variant = most valuable variant available here, above
# root.pe_best_min (0 = none). Planet designation, entertainment need and a random
# factor (0.8-1.2, entrepreneurial spirit) count.
pe_choose_variant = {
	root = {
		set_variable = { which = pe_best value = pe_best_min }
		set_variable = { which = pe_best_variant value = 0 }
	}
	pe_consider_variant = { V = d_pe_firm_aa CODE = 1 MODE = $MODE$ ENT = 0 PRIM = a DCLS = u }
	pe_consider_variant = { V = d_pe_firm_ac CODE = 2 MODE = $MODE$ ENT = 0 PRIM = a DCLS = u }
	pe_consider_variant = { V = d_pe_firm_at CODE = 3 MODE = $MODE$ ENT = 0 PRIM = a DCLS = u }
	pe_consider_variant = { V = d_pe_firm_au CODE = 4 MODE = $MODE$ ENT = 1 PRIM = a DCLS = u }
	pe_consider_variant = { V = d_pe_firm_cc CODE = 5 MODE = $MODE$ ENT = 0 PRIM = c DCLS = u }
	pe_consider_variant = { V = d_pe_firm_ct CODE = 6 MODE = $MODE$ ENT = 0 PRIM = c DCLS = u }
	pe_consider_variant = { V = d_pe_firm_cu CODE = 7 MODE = $MODE$ ENT = 1 PRIM = c DCLS = u }
	pe_consider_variant = { V = d_pe_firm_tt CODE = 8 MODE = $MODE$ ENT = 0 PRIM = t DCLS = u }
	pe_consider_variant = { V = d_pe_firm_tu CODE = 9 MODE = $MODE$ ENT = 1 PRIM = t DCLS = u }
	pe_consider_variant = { V = d_pe_firm_uu CODE = 10 MODE = $MODE$ ENT = 1.75 PRIM = u DCLS = u }
	pe_consider_variant = { V = d_pe_firm_xx CODE = 11 MODE = $MODE$ ENT = 0 PRIM = x DCLS = u }
	pe_consider_variant = { V = d_pe_firm_xy CODE = 12 MODE = $MODE$ ENT = 0 PRIM = x DCLS = u }
	pe_consider_variant = { V = d_pe_firm_xz CODE = 13 MODE = $MODE$ ENT = 0 PRIM = x DCLS = u }
	pe_consider_variant = { V = d_pe_firm_yy CODE = 14 MODE = $MODE$ ENT = 0 PRIM = y DCLS = u }
	pe_consider_variant = { V = d_pe_firm_yz CODE = 15 MODE = $MODE$ ENT = 0 PRIM = y DCLS = u }
	pe_consider_variant = { V = d_pe_firm_zz CODE = 16 MODE = $MODE$ ENT = 0 PRIM = z DCLS = u }
	pe_consider_variant = { V = d_pe_firm_mm CODE = 17 MODE = $MODE$ ENT = 0 PRIM = m DCLS = m }
	pe_consider_variant = { V = d_pe_firm_ma CODE = 18 MODE = $MODE$ ENT = 0 PRIM = m DCLS = m }
	pe_consider_variant = { V = d_pe_firm_mc CODE = 19 MODE = $MODE$ ENT = 0 PRIM = m DCLS = m }
	pe_consider_variant = { V = d_pe_firm_mt CODE = 20 MODE = $MODE$ ENT = 0 PRIM = m DCLS = m }
	pe_consider_variant = { V = d_pe_firm_me CODE = 21 MODE = $MODE$ ENT = 0 PRIM = m DCLS = m }
	pe_consider_variant = { V = d_pe_firm_mf CODE = 22 MODE = $MODE$ ENT = 0 PRIM = m DCLS = m }
	pe_consider_variant = { V = d_pe_firm_ee CODE = 23 MODE = $MODE$ ENT = 0 PRIM = e DCLS = e }
	pe_consider_variant = { V = d_pe_firm_ea CODE = 24 MODE = $MODE$ ENT = 0 PRIM = e DCLS = e }
	pe_consider_variant = { V = d_pe_firm_ec CODE = 25 MODE = $MODE$ ENT = 0 PRIM = e DCLS = e }
	pe_consider_variant = { V = d_pe_firm_et CODE = 26 MODE = $MODE$ ENT = 0 PRIM = e DCLS = e }
	pe_consider_variant = { V = d_pe_firm_em CODE = 27 MODE = $MODE$ ENT = 0 PRIM = e DCLS = e }
	pe_consider_variant = { V = d_pe_firm_ef CODE = 28 MODE = $MODE$ ENT = 0 PRIM = e DCLS = e }
	pe_consider_variant = { V = d_pe_firm_ff CODE = 29 MODE = $MODE$ ENT = 0 PRIM = f DCLS = f }
	pe_consider_variant = { V = d_pe_firm_fa CODE = 30 MODE = $MODE$ ENT = 0 PRIM = f DCLS = f }
	pe_consider_variant = { V = d_pe_firm_fc CODE = 31 MODE = $MODE$ ENT = 0 PRIM = f DCLS = f }
	pe_consider_variant = { V = d_pe_firm_ft CODE = 32 MODE = $MODE$ ENT = 0 PRIM = f DCLS = f }
	pe_consider_variant = { V = d_pe_firm_fm CODE = 33 MODE = $MODE$ ENT = 0 PRIM = f DCLS = f }
	pe_consider_variant = { V = d_pe_firm_fe CODE = 34 MODE = $MODE$ ENT = 0 PRIM = f DCLS = f }
}

# Colony scope: start building the chosen variant on a free slot.
pe_found_variant = {
	if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_best_variant value = 1 } } } pe_found_firm = { CODE = 1 COST = 500 SITE = d_pe_site_city MONTHS = 16 } }
	else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_best_variant value = 2 } } } pe_found_firm = { CODE = 2 COST = 500 SITE = d_pe_site_city MONTHS = 16 } }
	else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_best_variant value = 3 } } } pe_found_firm = { CODE = 3 COST = 500 SITE = d_pe_site_city MONTHS = 16 } }
	else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_best_variant value = 4 } } } pe_found_firm = { CODE = 4 COST = 500 SITE = d_pe_site_city MONTHS = 16 } }
	else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_best_variant value = 5 } } } pe_found_firm = { CODE = 5 COST = 500 SITE = d_pe_site_city MONTHS = 16 } }
	else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_best_variant value = 6 } } } pe_found_firm = { CODE = 6 COST = 500 SITE = d_pe_site_city MONTHS = 16 } }
	else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_best_variant value = 7 } } } pe_found_firm = { CODE = 7 COST = 500 SITE = d_pe_site_city MONTHS = 16 } }
	else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_best_variant value = 8 } } } pe_found_firm = { CODE = 8 COST = 500 SITE = d_pe_site_city MONTHS = 16 } }
	else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_best_variant value = 9 } } } pe_found_firm = { CODE = 9 COST = 500 SITE = d_pe_site_city MONTHS = 16 } }
	else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_best_variant value = 10 } } } pe_found_firm = { CODE = 10 COST = 500 SITE = d_pe_site_city MONTHS = 16 } }
	else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_best_variant value = 11 } } } pe_found_firm = { CODE = 11 COST = 500 SITE = d_pe_site_city MONTHS = 16 } }
	else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_best_variant value = 12 } } } pe_found_firm = { CODE = 12 COST = 500 SITE = d_pe_site_city MONTHS = 16 } }
	else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_best_variant value = 13 } } } pe_found_firm = { CODE = 13 COST = 500 SITE = d_pe_site_city MONTHS = 16 } }
	else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_best_variant value = 14 } } } pe_found_firm = { CODE = 14 COST = 500 SITE = d_pe_site_city MONTHS = 16 } }
	else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_best_variant value = 15 } } } pe_found_firm = { CODE = 15 COST = 500 SITE = d_pe_site_city MONTHS = 16 } }
	else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_best_variant value = 16 } } } pe_found_firm = { CODE = 16 COST = 500 SITE = d_pe_site_city MONTHS = 16 } }
	else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_best_variant value = 17 } } } pe_found_firm = { CODE = 17 COST = 300 SITE = d_pe_site_mining MONTHS = 8 } }
	else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_best_variant value = 18 } } } pe_found_firm = { CODE = 18 COST = 300 SITE = d_pe_site_mining MONTHS = 8 } }
	else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_best_variant value = 19 } } } pe_found_firm = { CODE = 19 COST = 300 SITE = d_pe_site_mining MONTHS = 8 } }
	else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_best_variant value = 20 } } } pe_found_firm = { CODE = 20 COST = 300 SITE = d_pe_site_mining MONTHS = 8 } }
	else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_best_variant value = 21 } } } pe_found_firm = { CODE = 21 COST = 300 SITE = d_pe_site_mining MONTHS = 8 } }
	else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_best_variant value = 22 } } } pe_found_firm = { CODE = 22 COST = 300 SITE = d_pe_site_mining MONTHS = 8 } }
	else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_best_variant value = 23 } } } pe_found_firm = { CODE = 23 COST = 300 SITE = d_pe_site_generator MONTHS = 8 } }
	else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_best_variant value = 24 } } } pe_found_firm = { CODE = 24 COST = 300 SITE = d_pe_site_generator MONTHS = 8 } }
	else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_best_variant value = 25 } } } pe_found_firm = { CODE = 25 COST = 300 SITE = d_pe_site_generator MONTHS = 8 } }
	else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_best_variant value = 26 } } } pe_found_firm = { CODE = 26 COST = 300 SITE = d_pe_site_generator MONTHS = 8 } }
	else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_best_variant value = 27 } } } pe_found_firm = { CODE = 27 COST = 300 SITE = d_pe_site_generator MONTHS = 8 } }
	else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_best_variant value = 28 } } } pe_found_firm = { CODE = 28 COST = 300 SITE = d_pe_site_generator MONTHS = 8 } }
	else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_best_variant value = 29 } } } pe_found_firm = { CODE = 29 COST = 300 SITE = d_pe_site_farming MONTHS = 8 } }
	else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_best_variant value = 30 } } } pe_found_firm = { CODE = 30 COST = 300 SITE = d_pe_site_farming MONTHS = 8 } }
	else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_best_variant value = 31 } } } pe_found_firm = { CODE = 31 COST = 300 SITE = d_pe_site_farming MONTHS = 8 } }
	else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_best_variant value = 32 } } } pe_found_firm = { CODE = 32 COST = 300 SITE = d_pe_site_farming MONTHS = 8 } }
	else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_best_variant value = 33 } } } pe_found_firm = { CODE = 33 COST = 300 SITE = d_pe_site_farming MONTHS = 8 } }
	else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_best_variant value = 34 } } } pe_found_firm = { CODE = 34 COST = 300 SITE = d_pe_site_farming MONTHS = 8 } }
}

# Colony scope: buy a state district. Human empires on Free Market get an offer (one per
# quarter); AI empires and Laissez-faire buy directly.
pe_buy_or_offer = {
	if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_best_variant value = 1 } } } 
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { is_ai = no has_policy_flag = pe_order_free_market NOT = { has_country_flag = pe_offer_pending } check_variable = { which = pe_capital value >= 600 } }
			}
			set_timed_planet_flag = { flag = pe_cooldown days = 360 }
			save_event_target_as = pe_offer_planet
			root = {
				set_variable = { which = pe_offer_variant value = 1 }
				set_variable = { which = pe_offer_class value = 1 }
				set_timed_country_flag = { flag = pe_offer_pending days = 3600 }
				country_event = { id = pe.110 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { owner = { OR = { is_ai = yes has_policy_flag = pe_order_laissez_faire } } }
			pe_buyout_execute = { FIRM = d_pe_firm_aa CODE = 1 DISTRICT = district_city SITE = d_pe_site_city MONTHS = 8 MINERALS = 500 TRADE = 100 PRICE = 600 }
		}
	 }
	else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_best_variant value = 2 } } } 
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { is_ai = no has_policy_flag = pe_order_free_market NOT = { has_country_flag = pe_offer_pending } check_variable = { which = pe_capital value >= 600 } }
			}
			set_timed_planet_flag = { flag = pe_cooldown days = 360 }
			save_event_target_as = pe_offer_planet
			root = {
				set_variable = { which = pe_offer_variant value = 2 }
				set_variable = { which = pe_offer_class value = 1 }
				set_timed_country_flag = { flag = pe_offer_pending days = 3600 }
				country_event = { id = pe.110 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { owner = { OR = { is_ai = yes has_policy_flag = pe_order_laissez_faire } } }

# Colony scope, monthly: a finished construction site becomes its firm.
pe_site_complete = {
	root = { set_variable = { which = pe_site_done value = 0 } }
	random_deposit = {
		limit = { has_deposit_category = pe_deposit_cat_sites check_variable = { which = pe_left value <= 0 } }
		root = {
			set_variable = { which = pe_site_done value = 1 }
			set_variable = { which = pe_chg_code value = prev.pe_target }
			set_variable = { which = pe_chg_stage value = prev.pe_tstage }
			set_variable = { which = pe_chg_fcap value = prev.pe_fcap }
			set_variable = { which = pe_chg_type value = prev.pe_kind }
		}
		remove_deposit = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_site_done value = 1 } } }
		save_event_target_as = pe_msg_planet
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_chg_code value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_chg_stage value = 1 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_firm_aa last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_code value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } } if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_chg_type value = 3 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_retool_d_pe_firm_aa days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } } else = { owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_found_d_pe_firm_aa days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } } }
		else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_chg_code value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_chg_stage value = 2 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_firm_aa_2 last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_code value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 2 } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } } if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_chg_type value = 3 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_retool_d_pe_firm_aa_2 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } } }

		if = {
			limit = { count_deposits = { category = pe_deposit_cat_sites count < 1 } }
			remove_planet_flag = pe_site
		}
		check_planet_employment = yes
	}
}

# Colony scope: carry out the stage change one firm asked for in its accounts
# (1 expand, 2 shrink, 3 bankrupt). The firm keeps its capital.
pe_firm_change = {
	if = {
		limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_pend_any value = 1 } } }
		root = { set_variable = { which = pe_chg_type value = 0 } }
		random_deposit = {
			limit = { has_deposit_category = pe_deposit_cat_firms check_variable = { which = pe_pending value > 0 } }
			root = {
				set_variable = { which = pe_chg_type value = prev.pe_pending }
				set_variable = { which = pe_chg_code value = prev.pe_code }
				set_variable = { which = pe_chg_stage value = prev.pe_stage }
				set_variable = { which = pe_chg_fcap value = prev.pe_fcap }
			}
			remove_deposit = yes
		}
		root = { set_variable = { which = pe_pend_any value = 0 } }
		save_event_target_as = pe_msg_planet
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_chg_code value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_chg_stage value = 1 } } } if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_chg_type value = 1 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_firm_aa_2 last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_code value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 2 } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_up_d_pe_firm_aa_2 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } } if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_chg_type value = 3 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_bankrupt_d_pe_firm_aa days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } } }

# Colony scope: the state buys back the least valuable firm at the buyout price x stage
# (if it can pay) and rebuilds the district. The firm's capital goes to the investors.
pe_nationalise_one = {
	root = {
		set_variable = { which = pe_worst value = 100000 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_rid value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_rid_best value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 0 }
	}
	every_deposit = {
		limit = { has_deposit_category = pe_deposit_cat_firms is_variable_set = pe_val }
		root = { change_variable = { which = pe_rid value = 1 } }
		set_variable = { which = pe_rid value = root.pe_rid }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_val value < root.pe_worst } }
			root = {
				set_variable = { which = pe_worst value = prev.pe_val }
				set_variable = { which = pe_rid_best value = prev.pe_rid }
			}
		}
	}
	random_deposit = {
		limit = { has_deposit_category = pe_deposit_cat_firms is_variable_set = pe_val check_variable = { which = pe_rid value = root.pe_rid_best } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 1 } planet_owner = { has_resource = { type = minerals amount >= 500 } has_resource = { type = trade amount >= 100 } } }
			planet_owner = { add_resource = { minerals = -500 trade = -100 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = 600 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_fcap } }
			root = { set_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 1 } }
			remove_deposit = yes
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 2 } planet_owner = { has_resource = { type = minerals amount >= 750 } has_resource = { type = trade amount >= 150 } } }
			planet_owner = { add_resource = { minerals = -750 trade = -150 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = 900 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_fcap } }
			root = { set_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 2 } }
			remove_deposit = yes
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 3 } planet_owner = { has_resource = { type = minerals amount >= 1000 } has_resource = { type = trade amount >= 200 } } }
			planet_owner = { add_resource = { minerals = -1000 trade = -200 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = 1200 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_fcap } }
			root = { set_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 3 } }
			remove_deposit = yes
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 2 } check_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 1 } planet_owner = { has_resource = { type = minerals amount >= 300 } has_resource = { type = trade amount >= 60 } } }
			planet_owner = { add_resource = { minerals = -300 trade = -60 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = 360 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_fcap } }
			root = { set_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 2 } set_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 1 } }
			remove_deposit = yes
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 2 } check_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 2 } planet_owner = { has_resource = { type = minerals amount >= 450 } has_resource = { type = trade amount >= 90 } } }
			planet_owner = { add_resource = { minerals = -450 trade = -90 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = 540 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_fcap } }
			root = { set_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 2 } set_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 2 } }
			remove_deposit = yes
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 2 } check_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 3 } planet_owner = { has_resource = { type = minerals amount >= 600 } has_resource = { type = trade amount >= 120 } } }
			planet_owner = { add_resource = { minerals = -600 trade = -120 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = 720 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_fcap } }
			root = { set_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 2 } set_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 3 } }
			remove_deposit = yes
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 3 } check_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 1 } planet_owner = { has_resource = { type = minerals amount >= 300 } has_resource = { type = trade amount >= 60 } } }
			planet_owner = { add_resource = { minerals = -300 trade = -60 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = 360 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_fcap } }
			root = { set_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 3 } set_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 1 } }
			remove_deposit = yes
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 3 } check_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 2 } planet_owner = { has_resource = { type = minerals amount >= 450 } has_resource = { type = trade amount >= 90 } } }
			planet_owner = { add_resource = { minerals = -450 trade = -90 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = 540 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_fcap } }
			root = { set_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 3 } set_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 2 } }
			remove_deposit = yes
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 3 } check_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 3 } planet_owner = { has_resource = { type = minerals amount >= 600 } has_resource = { type = trade amount >= 120 } } }
			planet_owner = { add_resource = { minerals = -600 trade = -120 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = 720 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_fcap } }
			root = { set_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 3 } set_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 3 } }
			remove_deposit = yes
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 4 } check_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 1 } planet_owner = { has_resource = { type = minerals amount >= 300 } has_resource = { type = trade amount >= 60 } } }
			planet_owner = { add_resource = { minerals = -300 trade = -60 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = 360 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_fcap } }
			root = { set_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 4 } set_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 1 } }
			remove_deposit = yes
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 4 } check_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 2 } planet_owner = { has_resource = { type = minerals amount >= 450 } has_resource = { type = trade amount >= 90 } } }
			planet_owner = { add_resource = { minerals = -450 trade = -90 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = 540 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_fcap } }
			root = { set_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 4 } set_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 2 } }
			remove_deposit = yes
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 4 } check_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 3 } planet_owner = { has_resource = { type = minerals amount >= 600 } has_resource = { type = trade amount >= 120 } } }
			planet_owner = { add_resource = { minerals = -600 trade = -120 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = 720 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_fcap } }
			root = { set_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 4 } set_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 3 } }
			remove_deposit = yes
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 5 } check_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 1 } planet_owner = { has_resource = { type = minerals amount >= 500 } has_resource = { type = trade amount >= 100 } } }
			planet_owner = { add_resource = { minerals = -500 trade = -100 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = 600 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_fcap } }
			root = { set_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 5 } set_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 1 } }
			remove_deposit = yes
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 5 } check_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 2 } planet_owner = { has_resource = { type = minerals amount >= 750 } has_resource = { type = trade amount >= 150 } } }
			planet_owner = { add_resource = { minerals = -750 trade = -150 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = 900 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_fcap } }
			root = { set_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 5 } set_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 2 } }
			remove_deposit = yes
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 5 } check_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 3 } planet_owner = { has_resource = { type = minerals amount >= 1000 } has_resource = { type = trade amount >= 200 } } }
			planet_owner = { add_resource = { minerals = -1000 trade = -200 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = 1200 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_fcap } }
			root = { set_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 5 } set_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 3 } }
			remove_deposit = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value > 0 } } }
		set_timed_planet_flag = { flag = pe_cooldown days = 180 }
		save_event_target_as = pe_msg_planet
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 1 } } } add_district = district_city }
		else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 2 } } } add_district = district_mining }
		else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 3 } } } add_district = district_generator }
		else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 4 } } } add_district = district_farming }
		else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 5 } } } add_district = district_city }
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 1 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_nat_1_1 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } }
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 2 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_nat_1_2 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } }
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 3 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_nat_1_3 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } }
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 2 } check_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 1 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_nat_2_1 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } }
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 2 } check_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 2 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_nat_2_2 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } }
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 2 } check_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 3 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_nat_2_3 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } }
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 3 } check_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 1 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_nat_3_1 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } }
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 3 } check_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 2 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_nat_3_2 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } }
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 3 } check_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 3 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_nat_3_3 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } }
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 4 } check_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 1 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_nat_4_1 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } }
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 4 } check_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 2 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_nat_4_2 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } }
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 4 } check_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 3 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_nat_4_3 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } }
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 5 } check_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 1 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_nat_1_1 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } }
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 5 } check_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 2 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_nat_1_2 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } }
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 5 } check_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 3 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_nat_1_3 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } }
		check_planet_employment = yes
	}
}

# Colony scope: the firm with the largest gain switches to the best variant available here
# (any class, same stage) if the gain is at least 3 trade per month. It closes for half the
# build time (a construction site). Cost: city 250 / rural 150 x stage size, paid from the
# firm's capital, otherwise from the investor pool. A rural target needs a free district of
# its type once the old firm is gone; if there is none, the old firm is restored, the
# cost paid back, and that rural type is not tried again on this planet for a year.
pe_restructure = {
	root = {
		set_variable = { which = pe_best_gain value = 3 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_rid value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_rid_best value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_retool_ok value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_rollback value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_paid value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_cls_val_all value = -100000 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_cls_var_all value = 0 }
	}
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_aa CODE = 1 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_ac CODE = 2 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_at CODE = 3 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_au CODE = 4 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_cc CODE = 5 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_ct CODE = 6 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_cu CODE = 7 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_tt CODE = 8 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_tu CODE = 9 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_uu CODE = 10 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_xx CODE = 11 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_xy CODE = 12 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_xz CODE = 13 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_yy CODE = 14 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_yz CODE = 15 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_zz CODE = 16 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_mm CODE = 17 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_ma CODE = 18 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_mc CODE = 19 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_mt CODE = 20 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_me CODE = 21 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_mf CODE = 22 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_ee CODE = 23 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_ea CODE = 24 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_ec CODE = 25 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_et CODE = 26 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_em CODE = 27 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_ef CODE = 28 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_ff CODE = 29 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_fa CODE = 30 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_fc CODE = 31 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_ft CODE = 32 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_fm CODE = 33 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_fe CODE = 34 }
	every_deposit = {
		limit = { has_deposit_category = pe_deposit_cat_firms is_variable_set = pe_val }
		root = { change_variable = { which = pe_rid value = 1 } }
		set_variable = { which = pe_rid value = root.pe_rid }
		set_variable = { which = pe_gain value = root.pe_cls_val_all }
		subtract_variable = { which = pe_gain value = pe_val }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_gain value > root.pe_best_gain } }
			root = {
				set_variable = { which = pe_best_gain value = prev.pe_gain }
				set_variable = { which = pe_rid_best value = prev.pe_rid }
			}
		}
	}
	random_deposit = {
		limit = { has_deposit_category = pe_deposit_cat_firms is_variable_set = pe_val check_variable = { which = pe_rid value = root.pe_rid_best } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 1 } } set_variable = { which = pe_cost value = 250 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 5 } } set_variable = { which = pe_cost value = 250 } }
		else = { set_variable = { which = pe_cost value = 150 } }
		set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_stage }
		change_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 1 }
		multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.5 }
		multiply_variable = { which = pe_cost value = pe_tmp }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_fcap value >= pe_cost } }
			subtract_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = pe_cost }
			root = { set_variable = { which = pe_retool_ok value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_paid value = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_capital value >= prev.pe_cost } } }
			root = { subtract_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_cost } set_variable = { which = pe_retool_ok value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_paid value = 2 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_retool_ok value = 1 } } }
			root = {
				set_variable = { which = pe_chg_code value = prev.pe_code }
				set_variable = { which = pe_chg_stage value = prev.pe_stage }
				set_variable = { which = pe_chg_fcap value = prev.pe_fcap }
				set_variable = { which = pe_chg_cost value = prev.pe_cost }
			}
			remove_deposit = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_retool_ok value = 1 } } }
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls_var_all value = 1 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_site_city last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_target value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_tstage value = root.pe_chg_stage } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } set_variable = { which = pe_left value = 8 } set_variable = { which = pe_kind value = 3 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls_var_all value = 2 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_site_city last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_target value = 2 } set_variable = { which = pe_tstage value = root.pe_chg_stage } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } set_variable = { which = pe_left value = 8 } set_variable = { which = pe_kind value = 3 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls_var_all value = 3 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_site_city last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_target value = 3 } set_variable = { which = pe_tstage value = root.pe_chg_stage } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } set_variable = { which = pe_left value = 8 } set_variable = { which = pe_kind value = 3 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls_var_all value = 4 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_site_city last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_target value = 4 } set_variable = { which = pe_tstage value = root.pe_chg_stage } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } set_variable = { which = pe_left value = 8 } set_variable = { which = pe_kind value = 3 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls_var_all value = 5 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_site_city last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_target value = 5 } set_variable = { which = pe_tstage value = root.pe_chg_stage } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } set_variable = { which = pe_left value = 8 } set_variable = { which = pe_kind value = 3 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls_var_all value = 6 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_site_city last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_target value = 6 } set_variable = { which = pe_tstage value = root.pe_chg_stage } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } set_variable = { which = pe_left value = 8 } set_variable = { which = pe_kind value = 3 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls_var_all value = 7 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_site_city last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_target value = 7 } set_variable = { which = pe_tstage value = root.pe_chg_stage } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } set_variable = { which = pe_left value = 8 } set_variable = { which = pe_kind value = 3 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls_var_all value = 8 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_site_city last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_target value = 8 } set_variable = { which = pe_tstage value = root.pe_chg_stage } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } set_variable = { which = pe_left value = 8 } set_variable = { which = pe_kind value = 3 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls_var_all value = 9 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_site_city last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_target value = 9 } set_variable = { which = pe_tstage value = root.pe_chg_stage } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } set_variable = { which = pe_left value = 8 } set_variable = { which = pe_kind value = 3 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls_var_all value = 10 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_site_city last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_target value = 10 } set_variable = { which = pe_tstage value = root.pe_chg_stage } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } set_variable = { which = pe_left value = 8 } set_variable = { which = pe_kind value = 3 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls_var_all value = 11 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_site_city last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_target value = 11 } set_variable = { which = pe_tstage value = root.pe_chg_stage } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } set_variable = { which = pe_left value = 8 } set_variable = { which = pe_kind value = 3 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls_var_all value = 12 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_site_city last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_target value = 12 } set_variable = { which = pe_tstage value = root.pe_chg_stage } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } set_variable = { which = pe_left value = 8 } set_variable = { which = pe_kind value = 3 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls_var_all value = 13 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_site_city last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_target value = 13 } set_variable = { which = pe_tstage value = root.pe_chg_stage } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } set_variable = { which = pe_left value = 8 } set_variable = { which = pe_kind value = 3 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls_var_all value = 14 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_site_city last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_target value = 14 } set_variable = { which = pe_tstage value = root.pe_chg_stage } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } set_variable = { which = pe_left value = 8 } set_variable = { which = pe_kind value = 3 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls_var_all value = 15 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_site_city last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_target value = 15 } set_variable = { which = pe_tstage value = root.pe_chg_stage } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } set_variable = { which = pe_left value = 8 } set_variable = { which = pe_kind value = 3 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls_var_all value = 16 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_site_city last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_target value = 16 } set_variable = { which = pe_tstage value = root.pe_chg_stage } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } set_variable = { which = pe_left value = 8 } set_variable = { which = pe_kind value = 3 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls_var_all value = 17 } } } if = { limit = { num_free_districts = { type = district_mining value > 0 } } add_deposit = d_pe_site_mining last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_target value = 17 } set_variable = { which = pe_tstage value = root.pe_chg_stage } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } set_variable = { which = pe_left value = 4 } set_variable = { which = pe_kind value = 3 } } } else = { root = { set_variable = { which = pe_rollback value = 1 } } set_timed_planet_flag = { flag = pe_noroom_m days = 360 } } }

			else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_chg_code value = 33 } check_variable = { which = pe_chg_stage value = 2 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_firm_fm_2 last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_code value = 33 } set_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 2 } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } } }
			else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_chg_code value = 33 } check_variable = { which = pe_chg_stage value = 3 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_firm_fm_3 last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_code value = 33 } set_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 3 } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } } }
			else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_chg_code value = 34 } check_variable = { which = pe_chg_stage value = 1 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_firm_fe last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_code value = 34 } set_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } } }
			else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_chg_code value = 34 } check_variable = { which = pe_chg_stage value = 2 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_firm_fe_2 last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_code value = 34 } set_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 2 } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } } }
			else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_chg_code value = 34 } check_variable = { which = pe_chg_stage value = 3 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_firm_fe_3 last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_code value = 34 } set_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 3 } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } } }
		}
		else = {
			set_planet_flag = pe_site
		}
		check_planet_employment = yes
	}
}
